tendances.description: Spot unusual deviations in an indicator and get a cautious estimate of the coming months.
tendances.aucunDescription: Set up a calendar on a dataset that has indicators to follow its evolution month by month.
tendances.observationsAide: The signal compares each value with the previous six months. It appears above 3.5 on the robust deviation score, or as soon as the value changes if the median dispersion is zero.
tendances.manquants: {count, plural, one {{n} month without a value.} other {{n} months without a value.}}
tendances.horsPrecision: {count, plural, one {{n} value shown without conversion and excluded from the estimates.} other {{n} values shown without conversion and excluded from the estimates.}}
tendances.previsionsAide: The estimate uses the median of the last three months. Once there are twelve historical one-month errors, the band adds and subtracts their 90th percentile around the estimate.
tendances.validation: {count, plural, one {Mean absolute error over {n} successive historical forecast · {mae}} other {Mean absolute error over {n} successive historical forecasts · {mae}}}
tendances.serieInsuffisante: {count, plural, one {Six consecutive usable months are required at the end of the period. Current series · {n} month.} other {Six consecutive usable months are required at the end of the period. Current series · {n} months.}}
